verdict.rationale: Bolna's public GitHub repository (bolna-ai/bolna) describes itself as an "end-to-end open source production ready framework" for voice conversational apps, so its source is readable on GitHub. The self-hosting docs (Docker/Kubernetes) fit with the code being runnable outside the hosted service. Missing for 10: the specific license is never named, it is unclear whether the hosted platform's features (dashboard, Agent Studio, workflows) are part of the open code, and there is no independent corroboration.
